_about: John Burnet (1863-1928), Professor of Greek at St Andrews. Classical scholarship (lane B pivot of 2026-10-10 from translations to public-domain English scholarship on the classics): Early Greek Philosophy, clean Gutenberg. The presocratics shelf passed this book over as a study, not a translation; it is taken here as scholarship. No uids minted. Also raw IA: Greek Philosophy, Part I: Thales to Plato (1914); The Ethics of Aristotle, edited with an introduction and notes (Methuen, 1900; Greek text with English notes, kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling); Plato's Phaedo, edited with introduction and notes (Clarendon Press, 1911; likewise); Aristotle on Education, extracts from the Ethics and Politics translated and edited (Cambridge, 1903); The Socratic Doctrine of the Soul (British Academy, 1916); The Greek Strain in English Literature (an address, 1920); Aristotle (British Academy master-mind lecture, 1924); Platonism (Sather lectures; University of California Press, 1928; this scan a University Microfilms facsimile of that edition).
